fusions.name: Dragged Under
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Clamps onto it from up to 4 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1 second and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Thrashing Roll
fusions.desc: Tumbles you through the shallows, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, knocking each back 2.5 tiles and leaving it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bait on the Bank
fusions.desc: Draws up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds, and you take 20% less damage for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Heart Left Ashore
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
